items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: He had a band manager whose name was Ira Mangle. ... I called the hotel, I called the Roosevelt, talked with Ira, told him the situation.

ctx.x: No, I don't have any background on that, but Louis was very happy about it. He was? Yeah. And of course, if you wanted to talk to Louis, you had to talk with Ira. You know how that worked.
